evidence_refs: Post-Joshua inquiry opens Judah first; the Judah-Simeon/Caleb-Achsah sequence reaches a first tribal non-dispossession coda at 1:21.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.1.1-Judg.1.21: Preserve 1:1-7 / 1:8-21 and 1:1-21 alternatives; the larger unit retains inquiry, campaign, embedded grant scene, and Benjamin coda.

evidence_refs: A new tribal subject goes up against Bethel; spying, spared guide, capture, and new-Luz notice close at 1:26.
Manasseh opens an escalating repeated did-not-drive-out register; Dan/Amorite pressure and territorial notice close it at 1:36.
Messenger movement from Gilgal opens a covenant accusation; weeping, place naming, and sacrifice close at 2:5.

challenges.claim: Preserve split Judg.2.1-3 / 2.4-5 as oracle versus response, but retain speech, weeping, place naming, and sacrifice as one oracle-response event; messenger/YHWH identity remains unresolved.

evidence_refs: Joshua dismissal resumes the inheritance setting; death, burial, elders, and replacement-generation notice close at 2:10.
Narrator apostasy formula opens the judge-cycle theorem; nations-left/testing language continues across 2:23 into the named nations, intermarriage, and service coda at 3:6.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.2.11-Judg.3.6: Preserve 2:11-23 / 3:1-6 as a live split; repeated nations-left and testing purpose support the larger parent.

evidence_refs: Apostasy formula opens oppression, cry, raised deliverer, victory, rest, and death closure at 3:11.
Again-did-evil opens oppression and cry; tribute, covert killing, delayed discovery, escape, muster, battle, and rest close at 3:30.

challenges.claim: Preserve splits Judg.3.12-18 / 3.19-26 / 3.27-30 as oppression/tribute, covert killing/escape, and muster/battle; the larger cycle retains causal setup, reversal, victory, and rest.

evidence_refs: After-him formula introduces and completes a compact named deliverance notice.
Renewed apostasy after Ehud opens oppression and Deborah-Barak commission; battle, Sisera flight, Jael reversal, and Jabin summary close at 4:24.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.4.1-Judg.4.24: Preserve 4:1-10 / 4:11-16 / 4:17-24 child scenes; retain the complete prose deliverance cycle.

evidence_refs: Explicit sang-on-that-day formula opens a framed poem; praise summons, theophany, muster, battle, Jael/Sisera panels, enemy/lover conclusion, and rest close at 5:31.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.5.1-Judg.5.31: Archaic Hebrew and disputed strophes at 5:5,11,18,23,27 remain appeals; do not promote speculative children or detach the rest notice.

evidence_refs: Cycle formula opens Midianite devastation and cry; a newly sent prophet rehearses deliverance, accusation, and not-listened closure at 6:10.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.6.1-Judg.6.10: Preserve 6:1-6 / 6:7-10 as oppression versus oracle; the cry directly occasions the answer.

evidence_refs: Messenger arrival under the Ophrah oak opens commission, objection, sign, fear, assurance, and altar/place notice through 6:24.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.6.11-Judg.6.24: Messenger/YHWH speaker shifts are unresolved; preserve possible 6:11-21 / 6:22-24 seam without identity ruling.

evidence_refs: That-same-night command opens altar destruction; city accusation, Joash response, and Jerubbaal naming close at 6:32.
Enemy assembly opens Spirit-clothing and tribal summons; paired fleece tests close at 6:40.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.6.33-Judg.6.40: Preserve 6:33-35 / 6:36-40 as muster versus signs, but retain the linked pre-battle preparation.

evidence_refs: Jerubbaal and the people encamp; two reductions, water test, dismissal, and retained three hundred close at 7:8.
That-night descent command opens overheard dream and interpretation; Gideon worships and returns with a deliverance summons at 7:15.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.7.9-Judg.7.15: Hebrew primary joined through 7:22; retain 7:9-15 / 7:16-25 as the literary alternative while recording the wider battle dependency.

evidence_refs: Division into companies opens instructions and enacted trumpet-torch assault; rout, wider muster, pursuit, and Oreb/Zeeb trophies close at 7:25.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.7.16-Judg.7.25: Hebrew primary preferred 7:9-22 + 7:23-8:3; exact pursuit/Ephraim seam remains unresolved.

evidence_refs: Ephraim direct complaint opens a compact rebuke-and-conciliation exchange whose anger abates at 8:3.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.8.1-Judg.8.3: Hebrew primary joins 7:23-8:3; retain that cross-chapter pursuit/dispute alternative.

evidence_refs: Jordan crossing by the exhausted three hundred opens requests, refusals, capture, return reprisals, kin inquiry, and kings execution at 8:21.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.8.4-Judg.8.21: Preserve 8:4-12 / 8:13-21 as pursuit-capture versus return-reckoning; larger unit retains threat and fulfillment.

evidence_refs: Israel offers hereditary rule; refusal, gold request, ephod/snare notice, subjugation, and rest close at 8:28.

challenges.claim: Preserve split Judg.8.22-23 / 8.24-28 as rule offer/refusal versus gold-ephod-snare-rest; retain the larger aftermath because the request follows the rule exchange and reaches rest closure.

evidence_refs: Jerubbaal returns home; household, seventy sons, Abimelech naming, death, relapse, and failed loyalty supply the actors and covenant setting immediately exploited by conspiracy, fratricide, and acclamation at 9:6.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.8.29-Judg.9.6: Preserve 8:29-35 / 9:1-6 as the death/apostasy versus conspiracy split; larger LOW unit keeps explicit causal setup.

evidence_refs: Jotham public summons opens the tree fable; direct application, conditional curse, and flight close at 9:21.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.9.7-Judg.9.21: Do not isolate 9:8-15; bramble wordplay and conditional speech require frame and application.

evidence_refs: Three-year rule and narrator retribution program open factional conflict; Gaal, Shechem, tower, Thebez, Abimelech death, and explicit repayment/Jotham closure end at 9:57.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.9.22-Judg.9.57: Preserve child seams at 9:25/26, 9:41/42, and 9:49/50; retain the complete narrated fulfillment parent.

evidence_refs: After-Abimelech introduces Tola; paired tenure/death/burial notices close with Jair at 10:5.
Again-did-evil opens widened service and oppression; cry, divine rebuttal, confession, removal of gods, and grief close at 10:16.

challenges.claim: Preserve split Judg.10.6-9 / 10.10-16 as apostasy/oppression versus cry, rebuttal, confession, removal, and grief; retain the complete accusation-response movement.

evidence_refs: Ammon and Israel assemble and ask who will lead; Jephthah origin, elders negotiation, witness, installation, and Mizpah speech answer that question at 11:11.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.10.17-Judg.11.11: Preserve 10:17-18 / 11:1-11; larger cross-chapter unit retains question and negotiated answer.

evidence_refs: Jephthah sends messengers; claim, counter-rehearsal, appeal, and refusal close at 11:28.

challenges.claim: Preserve Judg.11.12-13 / 11.14-27 / 11.28 as initial claim, full counterargument, and refusal; retain the entire messenger exchange so claim and answer remain together.

evidence_refs: Spirit movement opens vow and campaign; victory, daughter arrival, lament, vow fulfillment, and annual custom close at 11:40.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.11.29-Judg.11.40: Preserve 11:29-33 / 11:34-40; vow syntax and daughter fate remain unresolved for qualified Hebrew/legal/ancient-context review.

evidence_refs: Ephraim assembles and accuses; dispute, battle, dialect test, casualty notice, tenure, death, and burial close at 12:7.

challenges.claim: Preserve split Judg.12.1-6 / 12.7 as Ephraim conflict/dialect test versus tenure-death-burial notice; retain verse 7 as Jephthah cycle closure.

evidence_refs: After-him formula introduces three paired tenure/death/burial notices ending with Abdon at 12:15.
Cycle formula opens Philistine oppression; repeated messenger appearances, maternal/Nazirite charge, prayer, sign, recognition, birth, blessing, and Spirit stirring close at 13:25.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.13.1-Judg.13.25: Preserve 13:1-7 / 13:8-23 / 13:24-25; messenger identity and Nazirite terminology remain unresolved.

evidence_refs: Samson descends to Timnah; lion/honey, feast-riddle, coercion, answer, Ashkelon reprisal, wife transfer, crop burning, counter-burning, and further retaliation close at Etam in 15:8.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.14.1-Judg.15.8: Preserve 14:1-9 / 14:10-20 / 15:1-8; cross-chapter causal links support larger LOW parent and wordplay stays held.

evidence_refs: Philistine encampment opens Judah negotiation and binding; Spirit-enabled victory, jawbone poem/place-name, thirst prayer, water answer, and judge notice close at 15:20.

challenges.claim: Preserve split Judg.15.9-17 / 15.18-20 as Judah handover/Lehi victory-poem versus thirst-prayer/water/judge notice; retain victory and narrated answer/closure together.

evidence_refs: Gaza arrival and ambush plan open; midnight gate removal and Hebron-facing transport close at 16:3.
Afterward love notice opens four escalating tests; disclosure, shaving, unrecognized departure, capture, and hair-regrowth reversal signal close at 16:22.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.16.4-Judg.16.22: Preserve false-test children and 16:18-22 climax; hair, Nazirite status, strength, and divine departure remain narrated evidence, not mechanism.

evidence_refs: Philistine lords gather for sacrifice; mockery, final prayer, temple collapse, death comparison, burial, and judge notice close at 16:31.
Micah introduction opens silver/image/shrine sequence; no-king refrain, Levite arrival, hire/consecration, and prosper expectation close at 17:13.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.17.1-Judg.17.13: Preserve 17:1-6 / 17:7-13; cult/priest vocabulary and narrator irony remain held.

evidence_refs: No-king/inheritance problem opens scouts, Micah-priest encounter/oracle, Laish reconnaissance, and return exhortation at 18:10.
Six-hundred migration force departs; shrine theft, priest transfer, Micah pursuit, protest, threat, and withdrawal close at 18:26.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.18.11-Judg.18.26: Preserve 18:11-20 / 18:21-26; ephod/teraphim/priest terms remain evidence-only.

evidence_refs: Taken cult and priest lead into Laish destruction; Dan naming, image/priestly line, captivity notice, and Shiloh contrast close at 18:31.

challenges.claim: Preserve split Judg.18.27-29 / 18.30-31 as Laish conquest/Dan naming versus image-priestly-line/Shiloh coda; retain founding and cult epilogue together while Moses/Manasseh pressure stays unresolved.

evidence_refs: No-king frame opens concubine rupture and return; hospitality delay, refusal of Jebus, Gibeah lodging, assault, threshold, dismemberment, and national summons close at 19:30.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.19.1-Judg.19.30: Preserve 19:1-10 / 19:11-21 / 19:22-30; larger LOW unit retains accumulating cause and narrator perspective; 19:2 and death timing remain textual holds.

evidence_refs: All-Israel assembly answers the summons; testimony, collective decision, Benjamin demand/refusal, and opposing musters close at 20:17.

challenges.claim: Preserve split Judg.20.1-11 / 20.12-17 as assembly/testimony/decision versus Benjamin refusal and opposing musters; retain the conflict setup from summons response through battle readiness.

evidence_refs: First inquiry echoes the book opening; two defeats, repeated seeking, lament, fast, offerings, ark/Phinehas notice, and third promise close at 20:28.

challenges.claim: Preserve Judg.20.18-23 / 20.24-25 / 20.26-28 as first inquiry-defeat, second defeat, and intensified third inquiry; retain their progressive repeated structure through the governing promise.

evidence_refs: Ambush placement opens the third battle; feigned flight, reversal, casualty notices, six-hundred remnant, and city destruction close at 20:48.

challenges.claim: Preserve split Judg.20.29-36 / 20.37-48 as ambush/reversal versus detailed collapse, remnant, and destruction; retain battle and immediate aftermath as one third-attempt resolution.

evidence_refs: Mizpah oath opens lament and tribe-loss crisis; missing-assembly inquiry, Jabesh destruction, survivor provision, peace, and renewed insufficiency close at 21:15.

challenges.claim: Preserved competing boundary/evidence alternative for Judg.21.1-Judg.21.15: Preserve 21:1-14 / 21:15-25; verse 15 is a bridge and the exact seam remains appealed.

evidence_refs: Elders ask how to provide remaining wives; Shiloh plan, seizure, tribal return, and no-king/right-in-own-eyes refrain close at 21:25.

challenges.claim: Preserve split Judg.21.16-22 / 21.23-25 as Shiloh seizure plan versus execution, return, and final refrain; retain remedy and book-closing consequence together while oath/moral questions remain deferred.
